gaps.sentence: She was made ___ for three hours at the airport.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'be made' takes to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: The view from the top was ___ .
gaps.explanation: 'breathtaking' = so beautiful it takes your breath away.

gaps.sentence: I'll have finished the report ___ Friday.
He denied ___ the vase, though the camera saw him.
He ___ the flu last week and missed the finals.
gaps.explanation: 'catch the flu/a cold' = become ill with it.

gaps.sentence: The fire is believed ___ by faulty wiring.
gaps.explanation: 'believed to have been + participle' — the cause was earlier.

gaps.sentence: The first edition of the book ___ out in 1998.
